page.title: Recall trace
page.description: Trace a unit upstream to its mother and downstream through everything derived from it, with where each unit is now, who holds it and which shipments carried it.
page.notFoundBody: Check the number, or search by name.
page.startBody: Search for the unit involved in the recall. The trace lists its mother line, every unit derived from it, where they are, and which organizations received them.
page.noMatchBody: No unit name contains “{q}”. Try a shorter part of the name.

results.title: {count, plural, one {# unit found} other {# units found}}. Choose one to trace.
results.caption: Units matching the search

counts.shipped: Shipped out, in part or in full
counts.upLine: {count, plural, =0 {No unit upstream} one {# unit upstream} other {# units upstream}}
counts.downLine: {count, plural, =0 {No unit downstream} one {# unit downstream} other {# units downstream}}
counts.orgLine: {count, plural, =0 {No organization received units} one {# organization received units} other {# organizations received units}} ({shipments, plural, one {# shipment} other {# shipments}})

page.truncatedBody: Only the first {count} derived units are listed. Trace one of the listed units to follow the rest.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.hint: The family tree of the traced unit, read from left to right, forward in time: each fork is a unit that others were derived from, and every unit is a tip on the right. The traced unit and everything derived from it are highlighted.
lineage.caption: Lineage of {name}: upstream, the unit itself and downstream
lineage.generation: {generation, plural, one {# generation down} other {# generations down}}

organizations.title: Organizations that received units
organizations.caption: Organizations that received units of this trace
organizations.name: Organization
organizations.none: No unit of this trace was shipped to an organization.

shipments.title: Shipments in this trace
shipments.caption: Shipments that carried units of this trace
shipments.none: No shipment carried a unit of this trace.

peers.title: Other inventory of the same cultivar ({count})
peers.hint: Active units of {cultivar} outside the lineage above. They may share a source with the traced unit.
peers.caption: Other active units of the same cultivar
